envelope.description: Build the team gate core and the implicit claim

body.title: Build the team gate core and the implicit claim
body.summary: Add src/workflow/team/gate.ts with GuardedAction, GateOutcome, ClaimState, TeamGateRefusedError and teamGate(repo, unit, action): allowed with no tracker call for no policy, teamMode false, claimsEnforced false or an unguarded action; otherwise load the tracker with the claim capability, make its own whoAmI call, read the assignee live, treat the assignee as the holder (logins compared case-insensitively), give held-by-other naming the holder, refuse several assignees and every port or policy failure, and take the implicit claim through addAssignee for author and build. Logs every non-allowed outcome with unit, action and reason. Never throws.
acceptanceChecks: A repo with no policy, teamMode false or claimsEnforced false is allowed with no tracker call
An unassigned stage is allowed for author and build with implicitClaim true and takes no claim for approve-local or applying a finding
A developer assigned directly in the tracker is the holder, with logins compared case-insensitively
Another holder gives held-by-other naming them whatever their idle time
Several assignees, every port failure kind and an unreadable policy map to refused with the reason and never throw

tests.name: src/workflow/team/__tests__/gate.test.ts: teamGate allows with no tracker call when there is no policy, teamMode is false or claimsEnforced is false

src/workflow/team/__tests__/gate.test.ts: teamGate allows an unassigned stage for author and build and adds the actor through addAssignee (implicitClaim true), and takes no claim for approve-local or applying a finding
src/workflow/team/__tests__/gate.test.ts: teamGate recognises a developer assigned directly in the tracker as the holder with no separate claim, comparing logins case-insensitively
src/workflow/team/__tests__/gate.test.ts: teamGate returns held-by-other naming the holder for author, build, approve-local, apply and open-signoff, whatever the holder's idle time
